format: flexible_field v1: little-endian arrays in flexible_field.bin, x fastest (index = (k * ny + j) * nx + i), voxel centre = origin + (i + 0.5, j + 0.5, k + 0.5) * spacing

arrays.name: density
arrays.meaning: -1 off the lattice; 0 lattice no loaded stack designs; else the core density

arrays.name: owner
arrays.meaning: face_region_id of the owning stack (a press: its first region); -1 none

arrays.name: runner_up
arrays.meaning: the other stack under the voxel; -1 none (A6)

arrays.name: filled_density
arrays.meaning: every voxel's density after the fill rule (what is drawn)

arrays.name: filled_owner
arrays.meaning: the owner carried through the fill

filled_rule: every voxel with no density takes the density and owner of the nearest assigned voxel, breadth-first over the 6-neighbourhood, seeds in index order, neighbours +x -x +y -y +z -z (the app's FlexibleLatticeField.inputs)
seam_rule: FlexibleGroupField.pressSeam: band 2.5 voxels, ramp 1 voxel, on the filled field
